title: AFRIPAL 2027
field: Parliamentary studies, legislation and digital governance
about: The International Association of Legislation calls for paper proposals for AFRIPAL 2027, on African parliaments in the digital age, held 22-23 July 2027 in Gaborone, Botswana, hosted by BIDPA. Proposals undergo double-blind peer review.
